title: Lemon Bay Boat Rental
specs: Located on Intracoastal Waterway near Manasota Key between Venice and Boca Grande
Access to secluded islands, restaurants, and beaches including Gasparilla Island and Cabbage Key
BlueWater Boat Club fleet includes premium boats from NauticStar, Sea Ray, Cobia, and SunChaser
Operators must have relevant boating experience and knowledge of safety equipment
Renters born after Jan 1, 1988 must provide proof of NASBLA or equivalent boating safety course
Renters born before Jan 1, 1988 must have a driver's license and prior boat operating experience
No operators under age 25 allowed to rent
Valid state or federally issued ID and major credit card required for $500 deposit
Boat club members must complete BoatUS Foundation’s Online Course and on-water orientation
Boat club allows spouses or children of age to drive with member present after training

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Experience the newest and best-equipped pontoon rental fleet in the area. Our friendly and knowledgeable staff ensure a seamless experience, so you can enjoy all the perks of boating without the hassles of ownership. Skip the hassle of cleaning and maintenance-Lemon Bay Boat Rental handles it all. Our team ensures each boat undergoes a weekly 30-point maintenance check and is cleaned and fueled daily, so your only job is to enjoy the water. Need a cooler? We offer large cooler rentals to keep your crew refreshed throughout the day. Just arrive, relax, and set off on your adventure. Located at Harbor at Lemon Bay, we offer a fleet of well-maintained boats at competitive rates, providing

blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats for luxury cruising and beach access between Venice and Boca Grande. The marina offers dry storage for boats up to 40 feet with full service including launching, washing, and fueling. BlueWater Boat Club provides members access to a fleet of premium boats with training and an online reservation system.
